{"id":1832654018,"question_id":4084,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"8 months","timestamp":1763407200,"status":11,"status_display":"Wrong Answer","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/1832654018/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Maximize Sum of Squares of Digits","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    string maxSumOfSquares(int num, int sum) {\n        string ans = \"\";\n        int digit_count = 0;\n        int req_sum = sum;\n\n        if(num == 1 and sum >= 10) return \"\";\n        \n        for(int i=9 ; i>=0 ; i--)\n        {\n            if(i <= req_sum) \n            {\n                ans.push_back(i + '0');\n                req_sum -= i;\n                digit_count++;\n            }\n            if(digit_count == num) break;\n        }\n    return ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"maximize-sum-of-squares-of-digits","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1134}
